# Spectralizer

> FFT spectrum analyzer: browser app, Windows desktop, and VST3/CLAP plugin. Open an audio file or watch a DAW input. Local, GPL-3.0-or-later.

Site: https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/
Repo: https://github.com/grishinskeo-ship-it/Spectralizer
Releases: https://github.com/grishinskeo-ship-it/Spectralizer/releases/tag/v1.0.0

## Product

- [Overview](https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/index.md): what Spectralizer is, who it is for, web vs desktop vs plugin
- [Web app](https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/web.md): run the analyzer in the browser, no install
- [Desktop](https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/desktop.md): Windows portable app, four tabs, hotkeys
- [VST / CLAP](https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/vst.md): real-time DAW analyzer, pass-through
- [Install](https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/install.md): downloads, FL Studio VST3 path, build from source
- [FAQ](https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/faq.md): which edition to use, FL Studio scan, license
